results.overview: During the Great War, in a small rural French village far from the front, a gamekeeper and his wife take in children displaced by the war.

results.name: Skippy the Bush Kangaroo
results.overview: Skippy the Bush Kangaroo is an Australian television series telling the adventures of a young boy and his intelligent pet kangaroo, and the various visitors to the fictional Waratah National Park in Duffys Forest, near Sydney, New South Wales.

results.name: The New Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
results.original_name: The New Adventures of Huckleberry Finn
results.overview: The New Adventures of Huckleberry Finn is an American children's television series that originally aired on NBC from September 15, 1968 through February 23, 1969. Produced by Hanna-Barbera and based on the classic Mark Twain characters, the program starred its three live-action heroes, Huck Finn, Becky Thatcher, and Tom Sawyer, navigating weekly adventures within an animated world as they attempted to outrun a vengeful "Injun Joe". After the show's original run, the series continued to air in reruns as part of The Banana Splits and Friends Show syndication package.

results.name: The Adventures of Gulliver
results.overview: The Adventures of Gulliver is a television cartoon produced by Hanna-Barbera Productions, created in 1968. The show is based on the novel Gulliver's Travels. The show originally aired Saturday mornings on ABC-TV between September 14, 1968 and September 5, 1970. 17 episodes were produced, which were syndicated as part of The Banana Splits And Friends Show in the early 1970s.

results.name: Tarzan
results.overview: Tarzan is a series that aired on NBC from 1966 – 1968. The series portrayed Tarzan as a well-educated character, one who, tired of civilization, had returned to the jungle where he had been raised. The show retained many of the trappings of the classic movie series, including Cheeta, while excluding other elements, such as Jane, as part of the "new look" for the fabled apeman that producer Sy Weintraub had introduced in previous motion pictures starring Gordon Scott, Jock Mahoney, and Mike Henry. CBS aired repeat episodes the program during the summer of 1969.

results.name: The Flintstones
results.overview: The misadventures of two modern-day Stone Age families, the Flintstones and the Rubbles.

results.name: Popeye the Sailor
results.overview:
Follows the adventures of the famed spinach-eating sailor man.

Popeye is one of the most popular cartoon characters of all time. This spunky but loveable spinach-eating sailor continues to delight young and old with his comic adventures, and the entire gang is around to provide plenty of rousing fun and action: Olive Oyl, Swee'Pea, Wimpy and Bluto.

results.name: Alfred Hitchcock Presents
results.overview: A television anthology series hosted by Alfred Hitchcock featuring dramas, thrillers, and mysteries.

results.name: Courageous Cat and Minute Mouse
results.overview: Courageous Cat and Minute Mouse is a children's cartoon television show that was produced by Trans-Artists Productions and syndicated by Tele Features Inc. in 1960. The characters were created by Bob Kane as a parody of his earlier works Batman and Robin and in many ways predict the more campy aspects of the later live action series. This series and characters are trademarked and copyrighted and is currently owned by Telefeatures, LLC.

results.name: The Epoch of Miyu
results.overview: After discovering that her wealthy husband has been unfaithful, a Chinese housewife resolutely divorces him and makes ends meet by working from the bottom up at a hotel, which is to be presided over by the hotel manager who previously tried to help her husband cover up his infidelity.

results.name: Rüzgarlı Tepe
results.overview: The daughter of the richest family in town, admired for intelligence and proper manners, finds love with Halil, who seeks to avenge his lost kin. Their unlikely bond faces obstacles from both families.

results.name: Fred and Rose West: A British Horror Story
results.original_name: Fred and Rose West: A British Horror Story
results.overview: Recently discovered police recordings and first-person accounts tell the story of Fred and Rose West, two of the UK's most prolific murderers.

results.name: World on Fire
results.overview: The story of World War II told through the intertwining fates of ordinary people from all sides of this global conflict as they grapple with the effect of the war on their everyday lives.

results.name: The Bastard Son & the Devil Himself
results.original_name: The Bastard Son & the Devil Himself
results.overview: Caught between two warring clans, the son of a notorious witch responsible for a deadly massacre tries to find his place in the world — and his powers.

results.name: Angels of Death
results.overview: Most girls waking up without any memory and meeting a serial killer would panic, but not Rachel. In fact, far from being her biggest problem, killer Zack might just prove a convenient resource when it comes to finding a way out of the building in which they're both trapped!

results.name: Mehmed: The Conqueror
results.overview: Fatih series will be about the life of Ottoman sultan Fatih Sultan Mehmet.

results.name: Inari Kon Kon
results.original_name: いなり、こんこん、恋いろは。
results.overview: Fushimi Inari is a shy, not-so-bright middle school girl living in Kyoto's Fushimi ward. She has a crush on her classmate Tanbabashi, but cannot express her feelings. One day, as thanks for helping a fox pup, the deity Uka no Mitama no Kami grants her the ability to change her form.

results.name: Paytakht
results.overview: "Paytakht" is a popular Iranian television series that follows the everyday lives of the Mamooli family, a Mazandarani household living in the village of Aliabad. The story centres on Naqi Mamooli, his wife Homa Saadat, their twin daughters Sara and Nika, Naqi's elderly father, Baba Panjali, who suffers from Alzheimer's disease, and Arastoo Amel, Naqi's cousin. Throughout the series, the family finds itself in a variety of humorous situations and unexpected adventures, creating a heart-warming blend of comedy and family drama.

results.name: The Musketeers
results.overview: Set in 17th century Paris, musketeers Athos, Porthos, Aramis and D'Artagnan are members of an elite band of soldiers who fight for what is just. They are heroes in the truest and most abiding sense – men that can be trusted and believed in to do the right thing, regardless of personal risk.

results.name: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World
results.original_name: 冰剣の魔術師が世界を統べる
results.overview: The Arnold Academy of Magic is a school for the elite...and Ray White is just your ordinary guy. In fact, he doesn't seem particularly skilled with magic at all, and is a bit of a klutz. Which is why he has nothing to do with the rumor that one of the great magicians, the Iceblade Sorcerer, is a member of the incoming class...right?

results.name: Camellias
results.overview: After learning of her sister's death, Jiang Yukui, the saintess of the Zhao Clan, embarks on a quest for revenge. Alongside the powerful Feng Ye, she becomes entangled in a dangerous struggle against a tyrannical ruler, only to uncover a shocking truth that changes everything she thought she knew about her family and destiny.

results.name: Kirio Fanclub
results.overview: Two high school friends become obsessed with their classmate Kirio, leading to wild schemes and hidden secrets that complicate their friendship and emotions.

results.name: Gunaah
results.overview: Betrayed by loved ones, the world around Shiva shattered! Taking a new identity as Abhimanyu, he endures many trials for a bloody vengeance, carved with love.

results.name: You Are My Secret
results.overview: Lobby manager Tu Xiaoning and rising business star Ji Yuheng reconnect as childhood friends with a shared goal of marriage. As their lives intertwine through work and love, they navigate the complexities of relationships, balancing their dual roles as colleagues and newlyweds.

results.name: Crime Scene Berlin: Nightlife Killer
results.overview: In 2012, a string of grisly murders sent shock waves through the Berlin party scene. The killer remained at large — until one of his targets survived.

results.name: Wanru's Journey
results.overview:
An adventure begins with a mistaken identity after a nobody pretends to be the illegitimate daughter of the Murong family.

Ever since Murong Zhuwan faked her identity to pretend to be from a prominent family, she is pulled into bloody disputes in the pugilistic world. Clueless about matters of the heart, she becomes enamoured by martial arts genius Murong Chong and also meets the gentle Fu Hong, whose love has turned to hate after thinking that he's been betrayed. Their experiences allow them to grow into chivalrous heroes who fight for the people.

results.name: Who Killed Robert Wone?
results.overview: Details the 2006 murder of Robert Wone, a young attorney who was found mysteriously stabbed to death at a friend’s home in Washington, D.C.

results.name: Daniel Spellbound
results.overview: In New York City, a teenage tracker makes his living selling hard-to-find mystical items to sorcerers — but dealing in magic can be risky business.

results.name: Darmaduman
results.overview: The Servet family moves from Eskişehir to Istanbul for family reasons and find themselves in a totally different environment. As the twins Kerem and Ece try to blend in with the environment in the private college they just started, they will meet completely different people. While taking the path towards adulthood step-by-step suffering from growing pains, they will go on a long journey called youth where they will discover themselves while being scattered with mistakes and the excitements of first love.As the twins are tested with growing pains, the confrontation between their father Harun and his father who he hasn’t seen for 25 years will challenge the whole family. On the other hand, their mother Beliz is going to enter a new era where she will discover herself. When Asaf and Ayla start to live under the same roof with their son and their grandchildren after 25 years, their conflicts will make them understand that growth and maturity spread out over a lifetime.

results.name: Shinobi no Ittoki
results.overview: A descendent of the Iga Ninja Clan trains to become a shinobi and fights against the rival Koga Clan!

results.name: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
results.original_name: Are You Afraid of the Dark?
results.overview: Each season of this horror anthology series follows a different group of kids, members of the Midnight Society, as they discover terrifying curses and creatures.

results.name: Web of Make Believe: Death, Lies and the Internet
results.original_name: Web of Make Believe: Death, Lies and the Internet
results.overview: Conspiracy. Fraud. Violence. Murder. What starts out virtual can get real all too quickly — and when the web is worldwide, so are the consequences.

results.name: Now, We Are Breaking Up
results.overview: Will tell stories of emotional love and breakups. Ha Young-eun, a manager of the design team at a fashion label who is a trendy and intelligent realist. Yoon Jae-guk, a wealthy and popular freelancer photographer who also has the brains and looks. Hwang Chi-sook is a director of the fashion label’s design team who attended high school with Ha Young-eun and Seok Do-hoon is a skilled PR company CEO.

results.name: A Thousand Fangs
results.overview: An elite commando is on a mission, deep in the jungle, to find and destroy a powerful and mysterious leader.

results.name: Mouse: The Predator
results.overview: Special episodes of "Mouse" which will highlight the hidden narratives in the series that the audience may have missed.

results.name: Be My Cat
results.overview: The story revolves around the cute and lively proprietress Su Xiao He who runs a pet shop on the banks of Qingshan Lake in Qingqiu Country Jiangzhou. She accidentally picked up a "Blue Soul Orb" and awakened the Meow Star Prince from the DW galaxy. The  Prince incarnate as Mo Xiu Ran, a mysterious major general of the Qingqiu country. He and Su Xiao He signed a "master-servant contract" by chance. Although they were initially at odds, together they embark on an adventure, uncovering the secrets and found love in the process.

results.name: The Age Of Nature
results.overview: Explore humanity’s relationship with nature and wildlife, as scientists and conservationists from all over the world examine ways we can restore our planet. This documentary series asks whether newfound awareness of nature could bring about a new chapter in the human story.

results.name: Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector
results.original_name: Lincoln Rhyme: Hunt for the Bone Collector
results.overview: Former NYPD detective and forensic genius Lincoln Rhyme was at the top of his game until a serious accident at the hands of a notorious serial killer forced him out of the field. When Amelia Sachs, an intuitive young officer who has a gift for profiling, finds herself hot on the killer's trail, Rhyme finds a partner for this new game of cat and mouse.

results.name: When Time Stopped
results.overview: A man goes back and forth in the time-space continuum, with no regard for the passing of time and aging. Joon Woo leads a lonely existence due to his special ability. One day, he meets a woman who makes time matter for the first time in his life. Will he be able to be with her?

results.name: Untouchable Lovers
results.overview: Tianji Tower plots to overthrow the tyrant Liu Ziye by replacing his sister, Princess Liu Chuyu, with their disciple Zhu Que. She meets Rong Zhi, a secret Northern Wei spy, and their romance is shattered by betrayal. Rong Zhi fakes his death, and both later lose their memories. Five years later, they reunite when Chuyu is sent to marry Northern Wei’s Prince Regent—Rong Zhi himself.

results.name: Salamander
results.overview: A police inspector investigates the robbery of 66 safe deposit boxes at a private bank in Brussels.

results.name: Dead of Summer
results.overview: Set in the late 1980s, school is out for the summer, and a sun-drenched season of firsts beckons the counselors at Camp Clearwater, a seemingly idyllic Midwestern summer camp, including first loves, first kisses – and first kills. Clearwater’s dark, ancient mythology awakens, and what was supposed to be a summer of fun soon turns into one of unforgettable scares and evil at every turn.

results.name: Battle of Changsha
results.overview: In 1938, as war engulfs Changsha, the Hu family struggles to protect their twins. Amid loss and destruction, Xiangxiang faces love, tragedy, and duty, while the people of Hunan unite to resist the Japanese invasion.

results.name: Badalte Rishton Ki Dastaan
results.overview: Badalte Rishton Ki Dastaan is an Indian television drama series which premiered on March 18, 2013 on Zee TV. The series is a Hindi version of Zee Bangla's show Khela, and is produced by Ravi Ojha. The show was first aired on March 18, 2013 at 10pm IST, but due to the new reality show 'Connected Hum Tum' replacing it at the 10pm time slot, it was moved to the 11pm time slot. Due to low TRP's and despite the fact that the show had a good storyline & cast, it failed to woo the audience and therefore it concludes that Dastaan will go of air from June 28, 2013 and Film Farm's upcoming show is to replace it.

results.name: Time Goes By
results.overview: Set in the 1960s, the story of the Akarsu family includes Ali, Cemile and their four children: Berrin, a law student, Aylin and Mete, high school students, and 5 year old Osman. Ali begins an affair with Caroline, a Dutch woman, which leads to the disintegration of the family.

results.name: Human Target
results.overview: It takes a brave, selfless man to make himself a "human target" in order to save the lives of those in danger. Based on the popular DC Comics comic book and graphic novel, Human Target is a full-throttle action drama centered on Christopher Chance, a unique private contractor/security expert/bodyguard hired to protect.

results.name: Coffee Prince
results.overview: An immature company heir falls for his hardworking new cafe employee, but there’s a catch: he thinks she’s a man, and he's... ok with it?

results.name: Space Gen: Chandrayaan
results.overview: Indian space engineers face mounting pressure to redeem themselves following the Chandrayaan 2 lunar mission's unexpected outcome.

results.name: River of No Return
results.overview: In the Ming Dynasty, Crown Prince Zhu Zhanji races 2,200 miles from Nanjing to Beijing in 15 days to save himself and the empire.

results.name: The Countess of Monte Cristo
results.overview: 1815. When her fiancé is wrongfully imprisoned and her rescue attempt ends in tragedy, Mercédès vows revenge against those who destroyed her life.

results.name: Blossom in Darkness
results.overview: Qi Fengyin, a feared demon lord blamed for all evil, encounters Ya Mao, a girl whose flesh is coveted for its extraordinary powers. Forced into a bond, the two clash yet gradually become each other's salvation. Together, they unravel six bizarre mysteries involving deadly curses, demons, resurrection, and forbidden love. As they expose a hidden conspiracy, they clear their names, free the world from its shackles, and give lovers a chance to stay together.

results.name: Sword & Silence
results.overview: Six centuries of war have left the Three Kingdoms in turmoil. Facing powerful rivals, a small nation fights to unite a divided land.

results.name: Alicia's Law
results.overview: When her carefully built life comes undone, Alicia returns to practicing law and discovers that rebuilding her career also means redefining herself.

results.name: What a Boss Wants
results.overview: A struggling CEO's only hope to turn his career around lies in an indie singer – but neither of them expected to fall for each other.

results.name: One of a Kind Romance
results.overview: A romance driven by personal desire that unfolds when top actor Tak Mu-i and idol Ryu Min enter the ordinary daily life of job seeker Gong Yu-il.

results.name: Devils' Crest
results.overview: Yuma Ashihara was set to enjoy a test session of Actual Magic (AM)—the world's first fulldive VRMMO-RPG—together with his classmates Sawa Ashihara, Kenji Kondo, and Minagi Sano. The plan was simple: defeat the boss as a party of four, log out, and finish the test play safely — or at least, that's how it was supposed to go.

results.name: Francesca Next Door
results.overview: Woo-ju, a dedicated student preparing for medical school, has his life turned upside down when Na-young, a vampire transfer student from Romania, arrives at his school. As he becomes her keeper and helps her navigate school life, their constant clashes lead to unexpected feelings that leave Na-young questioning whether it's love or simply her vampire instincts.

results.name: When I Meet the Moon
results.overview: Shy and socially anxious Yun Li enrolls in graduate school to prove her independence and unexpectedly reunites with her high school crush, the brilliant Fu Shize. Determined to win his heart, she steps out of her comfort zone and pursues him. Their love flourishes, but past traumas and personal differences drive them apart. When Yun Li moves abroad, Fu Shize is forced to confront his deeply suppressed trauma. Fu Shize, now a renowned researcher, is determined to win Yun Li back when she returns. Through growth and perseverance, they find their way back to each other.

results.name: The Greatest
results.overview: Fresh off gold at the 1960 Olympics, young boxer Muhammad Ali (then known as Cassius Clay) sets his sights on the Heavyweight Championship. Contending with newfound fame, self-doubt, family conflict and a politically charged America, the once-in-a-generation prodigy discovers his greatest opponent won't be in the ring, but in a society that isn't ready for him to become his own man.

results.name: Scarlet Heart Ullavee
results.original_name: Scarlet Heart Ullavee ปาฏิหาริย์ข้ามกาลเวลา
results.overview: A modern-day hair stylist mysteriously travels back in time and lands in a princess' body, where she finds several princes interested in her.

results.name: Bass X Machina
results.overview: In a steampunk West overrun by outlaws, machines and supernatural forces, a father is forced to become judge, jury and executioner to protect his family.

results.name: Blue Planet III
results.overview: The third series of this nature documentary uses the very latest in underwater filming techniques to reveal brand new and untold stories from magical underwater worlds focusing on five major underwater habitats: the tropical seas, temperate seas, polar seas, high seas and deep seas. Venture deeper beneath the waves. David Attenborough reveals ocean life more surprising, more intelligent and more precious than we ever realised.

results.name: The Perfect Lie
results.overview: After a heart-fluttering date, Joonho, a heart surgeon with a perfect smile, and Jisun, a free-spirited teacher-librarian, share a special night. The next day, they meet at a police station with completely different memories. A shocking polygraph result turns their lives upside down.

results.name: Balaraw: Blood Island
results.overview: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

results.name: The One About Matthew Perry
results.overview: Told through intimate testimonies from close family and friends, this documentary event reveals the real Matthew Perry—generous, funny, vulnerable, larger than life—and the battles he fought to become the man behind the icon. A raw record of a life lived in full, and the honesty that became his greatest legacy.

results.name: Summer Vacation
results.overview: An ordinary teen girl longs for something new – will meeting a handsome boy in a countryside village change her life?

results.name: Final Table
results.overview: The Table: K-Chef 2026 brings together Korea's top chefs to compete for the title of the country's best chef. Mysterious world-renowned chef Chris K., also known as Kang Han, Song-yi, who is fighting to save her restaurant, perfectionist star chef Woo-jin, and chefs with stories of their own face off in a fierce culinary battle. More than a competition, they find comfort in food and one another.

results.name: Oh! My Guard
results.overview: A wildly unpredictable romance begins when a flawed “master of melodrama” actor encounters a mysterious woman who believes she is the female lead of a TV drama.

results.name: YAGA
results.overview: While a private investigator probes the disappearance of the young heir to a powerful fishery, he finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

results.name: Tigers Sniff the Rose
results.overview: Princess Danyang, Mu Wanyao, a formidable and arrogant royal, is married to Yan Shang, a cunning scholar of humble origins. Amid court intrigues, they move from rivalry and mutual suspicion to reconciliation, becoming powerful allies who join forces to break political deadlocks and safeguard peace.

results.name: Small Town Remedy
results.overview: After losing his job at a top-tier hospital due to an unexpected incident, Liu Zhengliang returns to his hometown and begins working in the emergency department of a local community hospital. While healing patients one after another, he finds himself continually healed by their resilience and humanity, creating a mutual journey of recovery and growth between caregiver and those in need.

results.name: Phony
results.overview: After waking up from a freak car accident, Sonny discovers that his mother has been replaced by an impostor.

results.name: Make Me Tingle
results.overview: A marketer with traditional views on love and marriage tries to navigate a connection with an adult toy company CEO with different values.

results.name: The Trap
results.overview: Follow famous author Lisa Konrad, who has not left her house for a decade after witnessing the murder of her sister. One night she sees who she believes was the murdered on television, and decides to use herself as bait to catch them.

results.name: The Lament of Autumn
results.overview: In the turbulent era of the Republic of China, student Ye Pingjun takes a job at a Western Hunan meeting house to fund her mother’s medical care. However, she's unexpectedly caught in the crossfire of an assassination attempt against the powerful Yu family’s fifth son, Yu Changxuan, and ends up accused of a crime she didn’t commit. Pingjun strikes a bold bargain: if Changxuan cannot identify the true culprit within ten days, he must clear her name. What begins as a high-stakes investigation quickly evolves into a calculated courtship as Changxuan maneuvers to win her heart while hiding a complex web of secrets. Will their blossoming romance survive the encroaching shadows of war, or will the secrets of their past pull them apart?

results.name: Treasure Island
results.overview: Young Jim Hawkins and his mother Bess come into possession of a legendary pirate’s treasure map and are drawn into a deadly voyage across the Atlantic, where Jim is forced to navigate mutiny, violence and betrayal, leaving him forever changed.

results.name: Dustfall
results.overview: Seasoned detective Tig returns to her hometown of North Gap after years in the city, and uncovers a string of drink-spiking assaults, the case is turned on its head when a primary suspect is found murdered.

results.name: Take Charge of My Heart
results.overview: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

results.name: Mírame así, el camino de Noa
results.original_name: Mírame así, el camino de Noa
results.overview: Noa visits her boyfriend in Argentina, where she meets Tomy. As she explores her musical identity under parental pressure, Tomy tries to leave his musical past behind while both navigate life in Buenos Aires.

results.name: Yal
results.overview: The story takes place in a village in the 1970s, where a series of murders targeting young women leaves the villagers facing a complex mystery.

results.name: The Vanishing Beauty
results.overview: Yu Meng, an only child from Jiangsu Zhejiang Shanghai and a popular internet blogger, is admired as a woman with a perfect life. On her fifth wedding anniversary, the bubble of her seemingly flawless happiness shatters. Her model husband is no longer so perfect, and her marriage begins to crack, while she also faces the threat of being financially exploited. With the support of her friends, Yu Meng reexamines her life and fights to take back control.

results.name: Below
results.overview: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a small Newfoundland town, a hard-bitten fisherman and his family fight to protect their close-knit community.

results.name: Cupertino
results.overview: A scrappy lawyer takes on a powerful tech giant in a high-stakes legal battle, navigating the cutthroat world of Silicon Valley while fighting for justice and the little guy's rights.

results.name: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
results.original_name: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。 ～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
results.overview: Rein spent years enhancing his guildmates’ gear with magic, only to be expelled the moment he enchanted everything. Unfazed, Rein steals back his magic, pours it into his own sword, and makes the best of his newfound freedom as he sets off as an adventurer. Along the way, Rein gathers a band of fellow outcasts and together they fight monsters and carve out their place in an enchanted world.

results.name: Merry Berry Love
results.overview: When star Korean spatial designer Lee Yubin loses everything, he heads off to a Japanese island. There, he meets Karin, a resilient strawberry farmer. Hailing from different worlds, their lives collide in a big misunderstanding. Buckle up for "Merry Berry Love," a sweet and sour Korea-Japan rom-com.

results.name: Magic Knight Rayearth
results.overview: A school trip to Tokyo Tower turns into a battle for another world when Hikaru, Umi, and Fuu are summoned to Cefiro! With Princess Emeraude captured, the magical world teeters on the brink of collapse. To save her, the three girls must awaken their powers, become the Legendary Magic Knights, and face deadly enemies before Cefiro is lost forever!

results.name: Inside the Circle
results.overview: Four lifelong friends are caught in a web of blackmail when a leaked video threatens to expose the secrets that could destroy their friendship.

results.name: kiDnap GAME
results.overview: Across seven Asian cities, strangers are forced into a deadly game where only one can save their loved one by beating the others.

results.name: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden
results.original_name: 凶乱令嬢ニア‧リストン 病弱令嬢に転生した神殺しの武人の華麗なる無双録
results.overview: A dying girl is saved when a fallen warrior’s soul is placed in her body, giving her new life, healing powers, and an unstoppable thirst for battle that brings chaos in its wake.

results.name: Hello, I Am a Witch and My Crush Wants Me to Make a Love Potion!
results.original_name: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。
results.overview: Rose, a lone witch who lives quietly by the lake, is asked by the knight she secretly loves to brew a love potion—for someone else. Though heartbroken, she cannot refuse him, choosing instead to treasure the fleeting time they spend together gathering ingredients. And as the days quietly slip by, Rose finds herself clinging to each shared moment, dreading the day the potion is finally complete.

results.name: Between Steps
results.overview: Minjae, a former swimmer, lost a leg to illness. Now a PhD student, he's built a quiet, controlled life, until Yujin, a master's student starting over after losing her way, throws it off balance. In a robotics lab, their romance turns fiery, bittersweet, and tender.

results.name: Romelia War Chronicle
results.overview: Victory over the Demon King should have been Romelia’s triumph. Instead, her fiance, Prince Henri, breaks off their engagement and sends her home in disgrace to a province in ruins. With no aid in sight, Romelia vows to raise an army, rebuild the ruined towns, and restore a struggling kingdom as new conflicts arise. The war may be over, but her story’s just begun.

results.name: PSYREN
results.overview: One day, high schooler Ageha Yoshina picks up a mysterious red phone card. Days later, his childhood friend, Sakurako Amamiya, who possessed the same card, suddenly vanishes. In search of her, he's drawn into rumors of a nationwide string of mysterious disappearances by a secret organization known as Psyren. When he accesses the group, a deadly game that changes his fate forever begins.

results.name: From Far Away
results.overview: Noriko is an ordinary high school student, until an explosion pulls her into a world of magic where no one speaks her language. Completely lost, Noriko is rescued by Izark, a shunned swordsman determined to kill the Awakening: a prophesied figure said to control the Sky Demon. As Izark and Noriko bond, he realizes she may be the very person he’s hunting.

results.name: GET JIRO
results.overview: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

results.name: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
results.original_name: 目覚めたら最強装備と宇宙船持ちだったので、一戸建て目指して傭兵として自由に生きたい
results.overview: When office worker Takahiro Satou awakens inside his favorite sci-fi game, he finds himself commanding a powerful spaceship. He takes to the stars as Hiro the mercenary, battling enemies and gathering allies along the way. But he soon faces a big problem: he has no home and, more importantly, no carbonated drinks! There's only one thing to do…buy himself a house on a planet!

results.name: Magical Explorer
results.original_name: マジカル★エクスプローラー
results.overview: Reborn in his favorite bishojo game, Kousuke gets the worst role possible: the forgettable sidekick. But armed with his knowledge of the game and this world’s largest mana pool, he might even surpass the hero! Now Kousuke must rewrite his fate and battle his way toward the heroines’ happy endings!

results.name: TANK CHAIR
results.overview: Nagi Taira was the strongest assassin until he fell into a coma protecting his younger sister from a bullet. However, his unique physical constitution allows him to regain consciousness for a short time when “intent to kill” is directed toward him. Now begins Nagi’s “rehabilitation”! He will fight powerful targets in his custom wheelchair until he achieves a full awakening!

results.name: Even Though I'm a Super Timid Noble Girl, I Accepted the Bet from My Cunning Fiancé
results.original_name: 弱気MAX令嬢なのに、辣腕婚約者様の賭けに乗ってしまった
results.overview: Pia Rockwell is a minor villainess in the game Caroline and the Rainbow Magic Sweets. At the end of the game, she's destined to be judged at her graduation party, see her engagement broken off, and be banished from the kingdom. Realizing she's doomed, Pia offers to end her engagement with Rufus Stan…but this only inspires the proud chancellor’s son to make a bet with her about their future!

results.name: A Tale of the Secret Saint
results.original_name: 転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひた隠す
results.overview: Fia always dreamed of being a great knight, despite her lack of talent as a swordswoman. Then, a brush with death in battle awakens memories of her past life as the legendary Saint who defeated the Demon King. Her powers return, but so do the enemies who killed her once before. Fia vows to conceal her true identity to survive. But how can a knight resist using her powers to help those in need?

results.name: Overgeared
results.original_name: テムパル～アイテムの力～
results.overview: Escape everyday life in SATISFY, a VR game where players earn real-world fame and fortune. One player, Grid, can't seem to catch a break in the game or in real life. That all changes when a challenging quest leads him to becoming the heir to a legendary blacksmith. His stats are reset to zero, but he's leveling up and crafting some seriously god-tier goods.

results.name: Kill Jackie
results.overview: Jackie Price has been living a wealthy, luxurious life for the past 20 years after escaping a dangerous past as an international cocaine dealer. But just as life begins to feel a little boring, she discovers that The Seven Demons, a group of the world’s most terrifying hitmen, have been hired to kill her.

results.name: Shadow Punisher
results.overview: Lord Qingyang's son, Li Si, devised a plan to infiltrate the Imperial Detective Division to uncover the truth behind the death of the Fourth Prince. There, he met and joined forces with Bai Zhenzhu, the finest female forensic expert in the land; and Meng Rui, a ghost-catcher renowned for his martial prowess but burdened with a deep-seated vendetta. Together, they formed the Divine Detectives. With seamless teamwork and unwavering determination, this trio ventured through perilous challenges, solving eight enigmatic and bizarre cases.

results.name: East of Eden
results.overview: In the early 1900s, a fiercely independent woman drives a rift between two brothers, igniting a saga that unfolds across two generations.

results.name: Coven Academy
results.overview: A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.

results.name: Winter
results.overview: Dr Ethan Winter, an analytical detective, partners with driven DI Lauren Bell. His deductive genius aids her murder squad, but he's haunted by an unsolved murder of someone close to him.

results.name: LEGO ONE PIECE
results.overview: The Straw Hats hit the high seas in a two-part LEGO special! Join Luffy, Nami, Usopp and the crew on their epic journey, fully reimagined brick by brick.

results.name: Irreplaceable
results.overview: After witnessing her mother's suicide following a divorce, Xu Chi defies her tragic fate by rising from an ordinary graduate to a sharp-witted top consultant. Drawn into the covert revenge scheme of seasoned partner Ye Xinzhi, who mentors her while navigating their growing mutual attraction, the duo confronts a crossroads when professional upheavals collide with their evolving bond.

results.name: People's Lives
results.overview: With its story full of love, ambition, and intrigue, the series, which is set to break the mold in the new season, focuses on the dangerous test faced by a young woman who envies the lives of others.

results.name: Dive into You
results.overview: An actress and her twin brother slip through time – and swap bodies – to save their friend's life.

results.name: S.W.A.T. Exiles
results.overview: After a high-profile mission goes sideways, Daniel 'Hondo' Harrelson is pulled out of forced retirement to lead a last-chance experimental SWAT unit made up of untested, unpredictable young recruits. Hondo must bridge a generational divide, navigate clashing personalities, and turn a squad of outsiders into a team capable of protecting the city and saving the program that made him who he is.

results.name: The Final Problem
results.overview: In the spring of 1959, a retired actor, who previously played Sherlock Holmes, must investigate a murder at a small hotel on a tiny island near Mallorca.

results.name: A Different World
results.overview: Deborah Wayne enters her freshman year at her parents' HBCU alma mater and finds their shadow difficult to escape. She sets out to build her own legacy – while having the time of her life – alongside a whole new generation of Hillman’s best and brightest.

results.name: Brothers
results.overview: Hollywood actors Matthew McConaughey and Woody Harrelson have been best friends for years, but a shocking family secret suggests their connection might be closer.

results.name: Minerva Academy
results.overview: At Minerva Military High School, teens navigate discipline, rivalry and family pressure as a young cadet searches for answers about his missing friend.

results.name: Line of Fire
results.overview: A family of law enforcement agents bridges personal differences and crosses professional boundaries as they tackle cases for the FBI, US Marshals, Secret Service and Department of Justice. After a seemingly cut-and-dry case turns into a deadly conspiracy, they must use the expertise from a lifetime of protecting civilians and politicians to protect one another and bring the killer to justice … even if it means betraying their sworn code.

results.name: Youth
results.overview: A 50-year-old divorcee searches for sex and love whilst juggling caring for her ailing parents and parenting her should-be grown up son.

results.name: American Hostage
results.overview: A psychological thriller anthology series focusing on a different hostage case every season.

results.name: The Blame
results.overview: Detectives Tom Radley and Emma Crane fall in love while investigating the small-town murder of a figure skater, until one becomes a suspect.

results.name: The Scandal
results.overview: In Joseon, a secret proposal ignites hidden desires in a gifted noblewoman, a famed lover and an unsuspecting lady caught in their dangerous game.

results.name: Not a Stranger
results.overview: After giving birth, painter Funda put her career on hold to focus on her child. Ready to return to painting, she finally finds the nanny she has been searching for: Nazlı. But the mysterious and increasingly unsettling woman soon begins to disrupt the seemingly peaceful lives of Funda and her husband İlker. What begins as a simple employment arrangement develops into a dangerous psychological game in which desire, secrets and loyalty are put to the test.

results.name: Spring of the Blade
results.overview: After losing her mother as a child, Xie Qingyuan returns years later to uncover the truth and seek justice. Reuniting with Shen Run, once a fallen youth and now a righteous court official, they join forces to expose corruption and right past wrongs. Through shared dangers and unwavering support, they grow closer, devoting their lives to protecting each other and their people.

results.name: Neagley
results.overview: Frances Neagley is a private investigator in Chicago and former military colleague of Jack Reacher in the Army's 110th Special Investigations Unit. When she learns that a beloved friend from her past has been killed in a suspicious accident, she becomes hell-bent on justice.

results.name: Golden Axe
results.overview: Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

results.name: City of Blood
results.overview: Berlin — a city-state on the brink. While a privileged few live beneath a climate-controlled dome, those outside struggle to survive in a world ravaged by heat, corruption, and crime. After years apart, sisters Bea and Phoebe are reunited and uncover a dark secret: Vampires are determined to seize political power — and blood has become the city's new currency.

results.name: High Value Target
results.overview: In 2003, John Nixon, a CIA analyst became the first American to positively identify and interrogate Saddam Hussein. During their time together, Nixon began to understand the potential consequences of the invasion, the humanitarian horrors and geopolitical turbulences that would follow Saddam's deposing.

results.name: A Love Other Than Yours
results.overview: A realistic, emotionally resonant romance about a couple in their tenth year together whose comfortable relationship is tested by unexpected feelings.

results.name: Against the Current
results.overview: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

results.name: The Trial
results.overview: A teenager and her father struggle for justice after she is sexually assaulted by the scion of a successful businessman. Not only will the father and daughter have to navigate a failed judicial system, but they must also contend with a wealthy adversary bent on using all his power to protect his son.

results.name: Crew Girl
results.overview: After a family scandal, teen rower Teagan Tao moves to a small town and joins an elite prep school's all-boys crew, sparking rivalry and attraction.

results.name: The Ordinary Jackpot
results.overview: An ordinary office worker wins the lottery – the amount isn't enough for him to quit his job, but it's enough to give him a new outlook on life.

results.name: Last Seen
results.overview: When emergency dispatcher Ian Ridley receives a frantic call from a teenager he believes could be his long-missing daughter, he stops at nothing to find her.

results.name: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga
results.overview: In 1990s Los Angeles, Wanda and Leon fight to take West Coast rap mainstream while gang wars erupt and record labels move to exploit hip hop culture for their own gain.

results.name: A Tale of Two Cities
results.overview: A pair of lookalikes, one a former French aristocrat and the other an alcoholic English lawyer, fall in love with the same woman amidst the turmoil of the French Revolution.

results.name: In My Prime
results.overview: In a small 1980s town, two families face an unexpected child swap between Qi Shi, a courageous girl with albinism, and Cao Xin, a disciplined boy seen as perfect. As they navigate identity, family, and love, both children and parents confront personal and societal challenges. Together, they struggle through hardships to find happiness and belonging in a changing world.

results.name: Salty Coffee
results.overview: The daughters of the İpekli and Kutaygil families—sworn enemies for years—unknowingly find themselves crossing paths with two sons from the same family. While Selin and Murat are busy preparing for their wedding, Murat’s older brother, Mehmet—who has just returned from America—crosses paths with Derin. Derin, who was preparing to marry Hakan, ends her relationship upon discovering his betrayal, and an unexpected bond begins to form between her and Mehmet. Thus, amidst a deep-seated feud from the past, the destinies of these two young women become intertwined with the lives of two brothers from the Aydınoğlu family.

results.name: Blossom Through the Cloud
results.overview: Once a flight attendant, Ruan Sixian pursues her piloting dream through flight school, later clashing and reconciling with aviation executive Fu Mingyu in a high-stakes race for industry innovation and mutual professional redemption.

results.name: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
results.overview: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

results.name: Mousetrap
results.overview: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

results.name: The Early Spring
results.overview: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

results.name: Pull Strings
results.overview: Li Changshou, a terminally ill patient in his previous life, is reborn into the Primordial World as a low-level Qi cultivator who cherishes life and avoids all karmic entanglements. Determined to dodge the great calamity foretold by the Heavenly Dao, he adopts the "Way of Steady" — his ultimate goal being to secure a humble post in the Heavenly Court and survive quietly. He operates with extreme caution: when still, he's as steady as an old dog; when he moves, he shakes the heavens. He firmly believes the era of bloodshed is over — better to trick than to kill, better to stay single than to fall in love. Yet enemies and beauties keep surging toward him like tides. Before he knows it, he becomes a mastermind pulling strings behind the scenes, entangled in power plays among multiple factions, orchestrating the "Dragon Clan's ascent to Heaven" — and even the great calamity itself accelerates toward him…

results.name: The Road to Splendor
results.overview: After being falsely accused of a scandal that ruins her reputation, noblewoman Fu Tingyun escapes with the help of salt smuggler Zhao Ling. Together, they expose government corruption and navigate the treacherous world of court politics. As they seek justice and uncover the truth behind her past, their bond deepens, leading them to a new beginning.

results.name: Anna Pigeon
results.overview: Anna Pigeon flees city life for the solitude of America's stunning national parks following a devastating loss; while Anna tries to outrun her demons, her focus turns to solving crimes that have taken place within national park grounds.

results.name: The Shards
results.overview: 17-year-old Bret Easton Ellis is in his final year at the elite Buckley prep school. Upending his world is the arrival of a mysterious new student, Robert Mallory, whose unsettling presence coincides with the activities of a serial killer known as The Trawler.

results.name: My Bias, My Boss
results.overview: A dedicated fangirl lands a job at a fashion company, only to discover it was co-founded by her ultimate idol. Determined to remain professional, she hides her identity, but is quickly thrown off course by the company's workaholic CEO. As secret unrequited feelings and hidden personal struggles entangle the trio, she finds herself torn between her lifelong obsession and an unexpected new connection.

results.name: False Memory
results.overview:
In his desperate quest to return to the past, Guan Chao scours the world for the "Burning Stone" — the energy source capable of powering the Time Gun. But his search takes an unexpected turn when he accidentally falls into the Memory Bureau.

To find his way back to reality, Guan Chao must join forces with memory administrators Fang Tang, Bai Zhong, and others, clearing BUG beings layer by layer through the strata of memory. Yet as battle after battle draws to a close, what awaits him is far more than corrupted data… The deepest truth buried within memory itself is beginning to stir.

results.name: Fightland
results.overview: A disgraced, formerly incarcerated boxing champion returns to London to seek vengeance against the crime syndicate he thinks betrayed him.

results.name: A Bona Fide Killer
results.overview: A seemingly ordinary working mother secretly lives as a legendary sniper who delivers justice where the law fails. After returning from a three-year hiatus, she must balance protecting her family with eliminating dangerous criminals, all while a determined journalist and a relentless detective close in on her hidden identity.

results.name: Furious
results.overview: FBI agent Alice Black is on the hunt for a mysterious and calculating female serial killer. Both walk their own paths toward justice, and as their lives start to intertwine, the line between right and wrong begins to blur.

results.name: President Curtis
results.overview: Follow the Commander-in-Chief and his eccentric staff as they tackle the kind of crises that Rick Sanchez could never be bothered with - from interdimensional diplomacy to paranormal investigations and unexplained phenomena.

results.name: Love on the Menu
results.overview: A cheerful side dish shop owner and a chef hiding a secret cross paths at a local market, but their path to romance won't be easy.

results.name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
results.original_name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
results.overview: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

results.name: Though I Am an Inept Villainess
results.original_name: ふつつかな悪女ではございますが ～雛宮蝶鼠とりかえ伝～
results.overview: Just as His Highness’s favored butterfly Reirin is beloved by the prince, jealous “court sewer rat” Keigetsu uses magic to swap their bodies—and their destinies. With a looming execution, Reirin embraces her new, healthy body, while Keigetsu learns Reirin’s life isn’t what it seems as she’s pulled into an inner-court conspiracy.

results.name: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You
results.original_name: スーパーの裏でヤニ吸うふたり
results.overview: Sasaki is an overworked salaryman drifting through the corporate grind, sustained by cigarettes and the cheerful service and smile of Yamada, the clerk at his favorite supermarket. But one night after a grueling shift, he arrives late to find Yamada nowhere to be seen. With nowhere left to smoke, his spirits sink—until a pierced young woman calls out to him: “You can smoke here.”

results.name: Tomb Raider King
results.overview: Chaos ensues overnight when mysterious tombs suddenly surface, filled with divine relics granting overwhelming power, triggering a global power struggle to claim them for dominion. Among the havoc, a raider, Jooheon Suh, is betrayed and left for dead until a second chance brings him back years before the relics. Fueled by fury and future knowledge, he sets out to raid each tomb before they arise.

results.name: Victoria of Many Faces
results.original_name: 手札が多めのビクトリア
results.overview: Betrayed by her own organization, Chloe flees her life as a spy and starts over under the new identity of Victoria in the Kingdom of Ashberry. Victoria wants a simple civilian life, but the locals have other plans, becoming enmeshed with an abandoned girl and a knight. As the trio bonds and Victoria’s past catches up to her, the skills she perfected as a spy prove useful in her new life.

results.name: THE GHOST IN THE SHELL
results.original_name: 攻殻機動隊 THE GHOST IN THE SHELL
results.overview: 2029, a near-future Japan. The full cyborg Motoko Kusanagi envisions a task force that preemptively strikes emerging threats. She and her team are scouted by Daisuke Aramaki as Public Security Section 9, AKA the "Shell Squad." An international conspiracy hints at a hacker known as The "Puppet Master." What fate awaits Kusanagi? What is the hacker's endgame?

results.name: I Want to Love You Till Your Dying Day
results.original_name: きみが死ぬまで恋をしたい
results.overview: At a secret academy where orphaned girls are raised as weapons, death is routine and grief is forbidden. Sheena, a 14-year-old who questions this brutal life, meets Mimi, a mysterious, blood-soaked girl who refuses to break. In a world built on violence, the two cling to fragile hope and fight to hold on to their humanity.

results.name: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky
results.original_name: 透明な夜に駆ける君と、目に見えない恋をした。
results.overview: Kakeru Sorano, a quiet university freshman who avoids others, meets Koharu Fuyutsuki, a blind girl who faces the world with quiet brightness. When she says, “I want to see fireworks someday,” something in Kakeru shifts. As they grow closer through small moments and shared loneliness, he searches for a way to make her wish come true.

results.name: Goodbye, Lara
results.overview: Once upon a time, a mermaid princess named Lara fell in love with a human prince. To be with him, she used a witch’s potion to become human—but the magic came at a cost: If she failed to find true love, she would vanish into sea foam forever. Now, 200 years later, Lara awakens in Lake Biwa with one final chance at life and love.

results.name: Family Register
results.overview: Judged as a mistress’s daughter, a young woman fights a stigma she never chose. Meanwhile, another woman’s life stands still after her husband's betrayal. Bound together by the death of the man who tore their lives apart, these two apparent enemies are forced to confront one another under one roof. As families scarred by hatred and heartbreak collide, old wounds resurface. Facing years of prejudice, they set out to reclaim their lives and transform their bitter fate into an unexpected family bond.

results.name: Oh Boy, Was I Wrong About Her
results.original_name: 転校先の清楚可憐な美少女が、昔男子と思って一緒に遊んだ幼馴染だった件
results.overview: Seven years after making a childhood promise to always be friends, Hayato is reunited with his formerly tomboyish pal Haruki at a city high school–only now, Haruki has transformed into the girl every guy dreams about! While Haruki’s looks may have changed, with Hayato, she’s still the same pal he remembers. Despite years apart, their promise and feelings remain and deepen into something stronger.

results.name: I Became a Legend After My 10 Year-Long Last Stand
results.original_name: ここは俺に任せて先に行けと言ってから10年がたったら伝説になっていた。
results.overview: Luck, an S-rank mage in the hero's party, makes a last stand against the Demon King to save his companions. When he finally returns victorious, ten years have passed, and the world praises him as a legendary hero who died in battle. Unable to reclaim his former life, Luck conceals his identity and begins again as "Lock," an F-rank adventurer forging a future in a world that moved on without him.

results.name: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for the Throne
results.original_name: 最強出涸らし皇子の暗躍帝位争い
results.overview: To the empire, Prince Arnold is one big joke, a completely inept prince outshone by his more talented twin, Leonard. But in secret, Arnold operates as Silver, one of only five magic-wielding SS-rank adventurers on the continent. As the bloody battle for the throne intensifies after the crown prince’s death, Arnold pulls the strings from the shadows to crown his twin emperor to his own advantage.

results.name: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires
results.original_name: ブチ切れ令嬢は報復を誓いました。～魔導書の力で祖国を叩き潰します～
results.overview: After being publicly betrayed by the crown prince and thrown into prison, noblewoman Elizabeth escapes her kingdom with the legendary Seven Grimoires. With help from a viscount from a neighboring nation, she rebuilds her life while plotting revenge against the kingdom that cast her aside.

results.name: Rich Girl Caretaker: I'm Secretly the Caregiver of the Most Popular Girl in This Rich Kid School
results.original_name: 才女のお世話 高嶺の花だらけな名門校で、学院一のお嬢様（生活能力皆無）を陰ながらお世話することになりました
results.overview: Hinako Konohana is the perfect young lady—graceful, elegant, and flawless… or so everyone thinks. Behind closed doors, she's a total disaster who can't handle basic chores! When ordinary student Itsuki Tomonari becomes her caretaker, he's thrown into 24/7 damage control, maintaining her "perfect" image. It's awkward, nonstop chaos—but it starts softening into something that feels like love…

results.name: Sparks of Tomorrow
results.original_name: 二十世紀電氣目録-ユーレカ・エヴリカ-
results.overview: In an alternate past, an unlikely duo team up to look for a missing catalog that could bring electricity to the smoke-filled streets of Kyoto.

results.name: The Duke's Son Claims He Won't Love Me Yet Showers Me with Adoration
results.original_name: 「きみを愛する気はない」と言った次期公爵様がなぜか溺愛してきます
results.overview: An arranged marriage. Two complete strangers. One adorable romance! When cheerful noblewoman Elsa is suddenly wed to the reserved duke-to-be Julius, neither expects their political marriage to spark something more. As awkward misunderstandings, sweet gestures, and growing feelings pile up, these newlyweds discover that falling in love might be the easiest—and hardest—part of married life.

results.name: BLACK TORCH
results.overview: Jiro Azuma is no average high schooler. A descendant of ninjas and trained in the ancient warrior art of the shinobi, Jiro is also able to talk with animals. After a mysterious encounter with an injured cat named Rago, Jiro discovers the feline is actually the legendary Black Star of Doom! Joined by the Bureau of Espionage, they fight off swarms of mononoke lying in wait to exploit Rago’s powers.

results.name: The Cat and the Dragon
results.overview: An orphan since hatched, a lone dragon named “Uncle Wings” is taken in by a family of magic-wielding cats and raised as one of their own. As Uncle Wings grows, he becomes the cats’ protector, determined to keep them safe from humans. But as he watches the cats connect with humans using their magic, Uncle Wings slowly starts to warm up to humans in this heartfelt, bittersweet tale.

results.name: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia
results.original_name: 天幕のジャードゥーガル
results.overview: After losing her mother and her homeland, Sitara’s despair transforms into determination with the power of knowledge. New possibilities unfold when a family of scholars takes her in, deepening her education. Meanwhile, Genghis Khan’s Mongol Empire conquers nation after nation, nearing Sitara’s new home. After the Fourth Prince of the empire takes her captive, a flame of revenge is ignited.

results.name: The Exiled Heavy Knight Knows How to Game the System
results.original_name: 追放された転生重騎士はゲーム知識で無双する
results.overview: Born into a prestigious family of master swordsmen, Elymas Edvaughn's future shatters when he awakens the so-called "defective" Heavy Knight class. Disowned and cast out, he regains memories of another life—and realizes this world mirrors a VR game he once mastered. Armed with knowledge no one else possesses, he sets out to rewrite his fate and prove the strength of the "weakest" class.

results.name: Chainsmoker Cat
results.overview: Catgirl Yani struggles to pay her rent and keep a job while feeding her smoking habit. As her loved ones' concerns grow, she must rethink her future.

results.name: KAIJU GIRL CARAMELISE
results.original_name: 乙女怪獣キャラメリゼ
results.overview: Kuroe Akaishi just wants a normal high school life—but that’s impossible with a rare condition that turns her into a giant kaiju whenever her emotions spike! Things get even worse when she falls for Arata Minami, the most popular boy in class. Now every blush, heartbeat, and crush could trigger a monster transformation. Can Kuroe survive high school love before it destroys everything around her?!

results.name: The Villager of Level 999
results.overview: In Earthclear, everyone is born into a fixed role, and villagers are the weakest of all. Most never rise above Level 5—except Koji Kagami, who is Level...999?! On a monster hunt, he meets Alice, the Demon King's daughter, and discovers they share an impossible dream: coexistence between humans and demons. In a world destined for conflict, they charge into battle to defy fate and shatter the rules.

results.name: The World Is Dancing
results.original_name: ワールド イズ ダンシング
results.overview: In 1374, amid the turmoil of the Northern and Southern Courts' long running conflict, a boy named Oniyasha is born into a family of sarugaku theater performers. He spends his days in a kind of quiet gloom, haunted by a simple but persistent question: Why do people dance? Then, one day, he witnesses a dance that he feels to be “good”—and everything begins to change. This is the story of the beautiful young boy who would one day shape the art of Noh and be remembered as Zeami.

results.name: From Overshadowed to Overpowered: Second Reincarnation of a Talentless Sage
results.original_name: 落第賢者の学院無双 ～二度目の転生、Ｓランクチート魔術師冒険録～
results.overview: The great sage Ephtal dies in despair after failing to reach the peak of magic—but 400 years later, he’s reborn with all his memories and power intact! In a world where magic has decayed and ancient spells are treated as miracles, Ephtal storms into a prestigious magic academy to reclaim the true art of sorcery. As his power shakes the world, long-forgotten legends begin to awaken!

results.name: Dara-san of Reiwa
results.overview: After venturing into a restricted, treacherous mountain forest, siblings Hinata and Kaoru meet a terrifying serpent god and become besties! Despite her initially scary appearance, the self-named “god of misfortune” is awkward, lonely, and surprisingly easy to talk to. This is the tale of an unexpected friendship, and the many comedic, heartfelt adventures that ensue.

results.name: Heroine? Saint? No, I'm an All-Works Maid (and Proud of It)!
results.original_name: ヒロイン？聖女？いいえ、オールワークスメイドです（誇）！
results.overview: Melody may be the heroine and saint destined to save the world from a rising demon king–but all she wants to do is become a perfect maid! Reincarnated in a story-based video game, Melody veers off the set story path, refusing to heed the call to action and instead using her powers to clean. Her new world becomes increasingly chaotic, and the story? Totally unhinged and unpredictable.

results.name: The Oblivious Saint Can't Contain Her Power
results.original_name: 無自覚聖女は今日も無意識に力を垂れ流す
results.overview: Overshadowed by her saintly sister Flora, plain Carolina seizes a chance to be useful by agreeing to political marriage with a prince rumored to be cruel. But the prince is nothing as expected—he’s a gentleman, and Carolina feels valued for once in her life. As Carolina blossoms, she discovers a sense of self-worth and a mysterious power, while Flora’s perfect life back home starts to crumble.

results.name: Adventure Time: Side Quests
results.overview: Young hero Finn and his magical dog best friend Jake embark on adventures across the fantastical land of Ooo — partying with cloud people and punching evil in the butt along the way.

results.name: Possible Love
results.overview: Defne, a woman in her thirties, is strong and composed, having built her career through hard work. One day, she realizes just how exhausted and isolated she has become; perhaps the time has come for love. However, two men who enter her life turn everything upside down. Caught between Kadir’s unsettling demeanor and Tolga’s games that shift the balance, Defne finds that nothing will ever be the same again.

results.name: Stranger Things: Tales from '85
results.overview: Winter. Hawkins. 1985. Welcome back to a town crawling with secrets, where beloved heroes are facing fresh mysteries... and an all-new breed of strange.

results.name: My Husband Is a Mafia Boss
results.original_name: My Husband Is a Mafia Boss
results.overview: Join the sweet and naïve Aemie as she navigates married life with mafia boss husband Zeke, and the dangerous world she’s about to enter.

results.name: LIAR GAME
results.overview: When Nao Kanzaki receives a strange letter and a suitcase containing 100 million yen, she learns that she has been selected to participate in the LIAR GAME. In this high-stakes psychological battle, lies, deception, and betrayal reign supreme. Naïve and honest, Nao turns to Shinichi Akiyama, a brilliant former con artist, to survive the twisted game. In a game built on lies, can honesty prevail?

results.name: Daemons of the Shadow Realm
results.overview: Yuru, a young hunter, lives in a small village deep in the mountains, hunting wild game and leading a humble life with Asa, his younger twin sister. Their peaceful lives are torn apart when a dragon’s roar echoes across the sky. What secrets lurk within their village? What fate awaits them?

results.name: MAO
results.overview: Eight years ago, Nanoka Kiba was saved from the wreckage of a fatal accident at Gogyō Town Shopping Center. Drawn to the abandoned passage of storefronts on her walk home from school in present day, she becomes inexplicably transported to Japan's Taishō period where she meets the mysterious Mao, a fellow traveler whose arrival at a ghost-inhabited village is simultaneous with hers. Together, they investigate the bizarre events that begin to occur around them, and Nanoka soon pieces together her broken memories of the accident and how she and Mao may have something more sinister in common.

results.name: R.J. Decker
results.overview: Ex-con photographer RJ Decker becomes a PI in South Florida, solving strange cases with help from his journalist ex, her cop wife, and an enigmatic woman from his past who may help or destroy him.

results.name: Scrubs
results.overview: J.D. & Turk scrub in together for the first time in a long time–medicine has changed, interns have changed, but their bromance has stood the test of time. Characters new and old navigate the waters of Sacred Heart with laughter, heart and some surprises along the way.

results.name: The One I Love
results.overview: Erkan Aldur, a young man from a wealthy Istanbul family, is stationed in eastern Turkey to complete his mandatory military service in a remote, earthquake-stricken region. In this harsh and unfamiliar landscape, he meets Dicle, a young woman who has lived her entire life in the village and whose world is shaped by tradition, family, and community. Their encounter brings together two very different worlds, setting in motion a journey of change, resilience, and unexpected connection. As Dicle steps into the unfamiliar and Erkan faces new responsibilities, their story unfolds into a heartfelt and transformative tale of love and courage, that bridges even the widest divides

results.name: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
results.original_name: The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins
results.overview: A disgraced former football player is on a mission to rehabilitate his image.

results.name: A.B.I.: A Broken Inheritance
results.overview: Dogan is a successful surgeon in Izmir. When he was young, a shocking incident with his father, Tahir Hancıoglu, caused him to break away from his family. Now devoted to saving lives, Dogan has almost no connection with his family except his younger sister, Melek. At Melek’s insistence, Dogan returns to Istanbul for his sister Gulusan’s wedding. His return brings back long-buried traumas and hidden crimes. Dogan meets Cagla, a strong, determined lawyer. Their painful pasts create a deep connection. The family’s enemy, Behram, watches from the shadows, waiting for the right moment to confront the past. An attempted murder on the wedding night changes everything. Old secrets surface and members of his family appear among the suspects. Dogan must make a choice: leave and return to his old life, or stay and face the truth by uncovering the secrets at the heart of his family.

results.name: You and I Are Polar Opposites
results.overview: Suzuki's a high school girl in love, but the guy she's fallen for is nothing like her! While she's cheerful, outgoing, and always trying to fit in, her classmate Yusuke Tani is stoic, quiet, and doesn't seem to care what people think of him. Will Suzuki be able to overcome her anxieties and ask him out, or will she discover that opposites really don't attract?

results.name: HELL MODE: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing
results.original_name: ヘルモード ～やり込み好きのゲーマーは廃設定の異世界で無双する～ はじまりの召喚士
results.overview: Kenichi Yamada, a single, 35-year-old businessman, has spent the majority of his adult life playing every MMORPG to hit the market. Tired of the constant cycle of repetitive, newbie-centric gameplay, he is immediately drawn in by the promise of a new game that, on top of being never-ending, offers up a "Hell Mode"—a difficulty level that makes it nigh impossible to level up but also promises uncapped growth potential. Upon selecting the newly released Summoner class, Kenichi finds himself reborn as Allen, an infant in a serf family, with nothing but his wits and old memories to guide him.

results.name: Best Medicine
results.overview: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they’ve got.

results.name: Hana-Kimi
results.overview: Mizuki Ashiya is on a mission: disguise herself as a boy and enroll in a male boarding school to meet her idol, high jump star Izumi Sano. But after successfully infiltrating the school, she discovers he’s suddenly quit the sport! Now Mizuki must dodge suspicion, protect her cover, and somehow reach the boy she came all this way for—all while surviving the chaos of an all-boys dorm!

results.name: Made in Korea
results.overview: In 1970s South Korea, follow two men on opposite sides of power — one driven by ambition, the other by justice. As their worlds collide, greed, loyalty, and survival intertwine in a battle that will shape a nation.

results.name: Arafta (Bound By Fate)
results.overview: Set against the picturesque landscapes of Turkey, Arafta unravels a tale of love forged in the flames of vengeance. Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy.

results.name: All's Fair
results.overview: A team of female divorce attorneys leave a male-dominated firm to open their own powerhouse practice. Fierce, brilliant, and emotionally complicated, they navigate high-stakes breakups, scandalous secrets, and shifting allegiances—both in the courtroom and within their own ranks. In a world where money talks and love is a battleground, these women don't just play the game—they change it.

results.name: The Forsytes
results.overview: Chronicles the lives of four generations of an upper-class family of stockbrokers, set against the backdrop of a rapidly evolving late-Victorian world.

results.name: Sheriff Country
results.overview: Mickey Fox investigates criminal activity and patrols the streets of small-town Edgewater while contending with her ex-con father and a mysterious incident involving her wayward daughter.

results.name: Boston Blue
results.overview: NYPD Detective Danny Reagan takes a job with the Boston PD and is paired with Detective Lena Silver, part of a law enforcement family comprised of District Attorney Mae Silver, Police Superintendent Sarah Silver, rookie cop Jonah Silver and Rev. Edwin Peters. Reagan hopes to reconnect with his son, Sean, in Boston.

results.name: This Sea Will Overflow
results.overview: In a land where people are accustomed to battling fierce waves and constant storms, the story of a woman who stands tall on her feet, with all her emotional strength, resilience and endurance, and a man who is passionate about his "love" and who competes with the storms of the Black Sea and struggles with its waves, comes to the screens with an effective script... The ups and downs of the mountains, the sea and the human soul are told through the eyes of a stranger who finds himself in the middle of the endless war between two mortal enemies.

results.name: Digimon Beatbreak
results.overview: Tomoro Tenma lives in a world where human thoughts and emotions, known as e-Pulse, power AI devices called Sapotama. But when Digimon begin materializing from Sapotama and feeding on e-Pulse, society begins to fracture. After Gekkomon appears from his device, Tomoro joins Glowing Dawn, a secret team investigating rogue Digimon and the dark truth of a system both fueled and corrupted by emotion.

results.name: A Wild Last Boss Appeared!
results.original_name: 野生のラスボスが現れた！
results.overview: An MMO gamer awakens as the Black-Winged Tyrant, Lufas Maphaahl, rising from her sealed fate—only to find this is very real. Her defeat 200 years ago unleashed monsters of death, and the legend is one of terror. Now, trapped in the body of history's most feared conqueror, he must survive a world that wants her dead…and uncover why he's here.

results.name: The Sisters Grimm
results.overview: One year after their parents' mysterious disappearance, sisters Sabrina and Daphne move to a magical town where fairytales are real and secrets lurk behind every corner.

results.name: Chad Powers
results.overview: Eight years after an unforgivable mistake nukes his promising college football career, hotshot quarterback Russ Holliday tries to resurrect his dreams by disguising himself as Chad Powers - a talented oddball who walks on to the struggling South Georgia Catfish.

results.name: The Lowdown
results.overview: Follow the gritty exploits of citizen journalist Lee Raybon, a self-proclaimed Tulsa "truthstorian" whose obsession with the truth is always getting him into trouble.

results.name: Haunted Hotel
results.overview: After inheriting a hotel from her late brother, a single mom moves in with his good-natured ghost — and high-maintenance guests who will never check out.

results.name: Halef
results.overview: A successful Istanbul surgeon who escaped his traditional Urfa roots is forced to return home when his family demands he assume leadership as agha and marry Yildiz to end a decades-long feud. Already secretly married to Melek, he becomes trapped between two women, two worlds, and a web of family obligations. As buried secrets surface, love, duty, and revenge collide inside a deeply divided and tradition-bound family.

results.name: Vampirina: Teenage Vampire
results.overview: Follow a tween vampire girl who leaves the safety of Transylvania to attend a performing arts boarding school. Living amongst humans for the first time, she pursues her passion for music while keeping her vampire identity a secret, something that’s made more challenging when her overprotective father charges an overzealous ghost to live with her at the school.

results.name: The Paper
results.overview: The documentary crew that immortalized Dunder Mifflin's Scranton branch is in search of a new subject when they discover a historic Toledo newspaper, The Truth Teller, and the eager publisher trying to revive it.

results.name: The Rainmaker
results.overview: Fresh out of law school, Rudy Baylor goes head to head with courtroom lion Leo Drummond as well as his law school girlfriend, Sarah. Rudy, along with his boss, Bruiser, and her disheveled paralegal, Deck, uncovers two connected conspiracies surrounding the mysterious death of their client's son.

results.name: Outlander: Blood of My Blood
results.overview: From the battlefields of World War I to the rugged Highlands of 18th century Scotland, two fated couples must defy the forces that seek to tear them apart, unfolding in surprising and unforeseen ways in this romantic saga that unfolds across time.

results.name: Leanne
results.overview: When her husband leaves her for another woman, a resilient Southern mom starts over with the support of her loving, but unfiltered family.

results.name: The Assassin
results.overview: Secluded on a remote Greek island, retired assassin Julie has a somewhat thorny reunion with her estranged son, Edward, visiting from England. Armed with questions around new information on his paternity, Edward battles to find the right time to speak to his frustratingly distant mother. But, when the moment finally presents itself, things take a deadly turn as Julie’s dangerous past catches up with her and they are forced to flee the island and go on the run together.

results.name: Bookish
results.overview: Gabriel Book, proprietor of an antiquarian bookshop, relies on his vast collection to unravel baffling cases. He nurtures a group of lovable yet troubled individuals, providing informal protection and guidance.

results.name: Tougen Anki
results.overview: After a Momotaro assassin suddenly kills his adoptive father, Shiki vows to avenge him. But first, he must learn to control his newly awakened Oni blood.

results.name: Clevatess
results.original_name: クレバテス-魔獣の王と赤子と屍の勇者
results.overview: One of the Lords of Dark Beasts, Clevatess’s reign shatters when he revives a hero he personally slayed and adopts an orphaned humanoid baby—the last hope to save a dying world. Now bound together, what fate awaits this unlikely trio?

results.name: The Black Dagger Brotherhood
results.overview: A brotherhood of vampire warriors protects their race from demonic lessers. United by tragedy, the few remaining fighters confront the lessers, striving to restore the vampire realm.

results.name: Adults
results.overview: A group of twenty-somethings in New York trying to be good people, despite being neither "good" nor "people" yet.

results.name: The Librarians: The Next Chapter
results.overview: A Librarian from the past time travels to the present and finds himself stuck here.
